title: Prompt Tuning for Audio Deepfake Detection: Computationally Efficient Test-time Domain Adaptation with Limited Target Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance (Equal Error Rate) of a proposed prompt tuning method for audio deepfake detection.
